task: We want to add 20 charging points by 1 March 2027. Using the observed usage data, which existing sites/areas show the highest saturation and are the best candidates? Give a ranked shortlist with the data behind it.
markdown:
## Answer
The most saturated well-observed sites in Bolzano are BZ_C_RISPARMIO_01 (occupancy 66.9%, full_time 46.2%) and BZ_BOEHLER_01 (occupancy 57.0%, full_time 57.0%) [E2, E3]. The two RISPARMIO sites together show the strongest signs of area pressure. Coverage is low everywhere (4.4% to 22.7% among the top sites), so this shortlist is provisional [E2, E4].

## Key findings
- Rank 1 by occupancy is BZ_C_RISPARMIO_01 (2 points): occupancy 66.9%, full_time 46.2%, 203 observed_starts, peak hour 08:00, coverage 14.7% [E2].
- BZ_BOEHLER_01 (1 point) has the highest full_time at 57.0%, with 170 observed_starts and the best coverage among the top sites at 22.7%. With a single point, "all busy" equals "the point is busy" [E3].
- BZ_P_VITTORIA (3 points) has occupancy 63.5% but full_time only 27.7%, and coverage of just 8.2% (exposure 110.55 h). It also has 757 gaps over 120 min [E2, E4].
- BZ_C_RISPARMIO_02 (2 points) has occupancy 51.9%, full_time 30.1% and the highest observed_starts at 261, with coverage 16.7% [E2, E3].
- BZ_PIAVE_01 (2 points) has occupancy 50.8%, 212 observed_starts and a peak hour of 23:00 [E2].
- BZ_C_AUGUSTA_01 (occupancy 56.1%, coverage 4.4%) and BZ_RESSEL_01 (occupancy 52.2%, coverage 3.3%) rank high but rest on weak evidence [E2, E3].
- No top-5 site is stale; latest observations are all from 2026-11-13 [E4].

## Recommendation
Provisional shortlist, ranked by saturation and evidence strength [E2, E3]:
1. BZ_C_RISPARMIO_01
2. BZ_BOEHLER_01
3. BZ_C_RISPARMIO_02
4. BZ_P_VITTORIA
5. BZ_PIAVE_01

Treat the RISPARMIO pair as one candidate area for expansion, after confirming that the sites are physically close. Hold BZ_C_AUGUSTA_01 and BZ_RESSEL_01 until better coverage is available. Before committing, check site capacity and local demand. The data cannot allocate the 20 points among sites.

## Limitations & unknowns
- Data show occupancy only, not energy, sessions, demand or faults [E1].
- Coverage is low, so occupancy rests on a small share of the 56-day window and may not represent the full period [E2, E4].
- 22 sites were excluded for under 24 h of exposure, so they could not be ranked [E2].
- Physical adjacency of the two RISPARMIO sites is unconfirmed.
- Space for new points at each site and the split of the 20 points are unknown.

## Sources
- [E1] dataset_overview — Open Data Hub South Tyrol EChargingPlug status, window 2026-09-19..2026-11-14
- [E2] rank_sites(metric=occupancy) — Open Data Hub South Tyrol EChargingPlug status, window 2026-09-19..2026-11-14
- [E3] rank_sites(metric=full_time) — Open Data Hub South Tyrol EChargingPlug status, window 2026-09-19..2026-11-14
- [E4] data_quality — Open Data Hub South Tyrol EChargingPlug status, window 2026-09-19..2026-11-14
